news.text: Our STIndex demo was accepted at [WWW 2026](https://www2026.thewebconf.org/) (Companion proceedings) in Dubai, UAE!
["Enhancing Reliability in LLM-Integrated Robotic Systems"](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0164121225002833) was published in the Journal of Systems and Software!

[Docs2KG](https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user=Yf6xHJ4AAAAJ&citation_for_view=Yf6xHJ4AAAAJ:Tyk-4Ss8FVUC) was published in the WWW 2025 Companion proceedings and presented in Sydney, Australia!
[OpenOmni](https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user=Yf6xHJ4AAAAJ&citation_for_view=Yf6xHJ4AAAAJ:d1gkVwhDpl0C) won the Best Demo Paper Award at EMNLP 2024 in Miami!
Joined [Telstra](https://www.telstra.com.au) as a Data Science Specialist, building GraphRAG and agentic retrieval for frontline customer service.
Our [study on prompt injection attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.03515) against LLM-integrated mobile robots was presented at ISSRE 2024 in Tsukuba, Japan!
Started my PhD in Computer Science at [UWA](https://www.uwa.edu.au), researching reliable and secure LLM agent systems!
Began tutoring at [UWA](https://www.uwa.edu.au): Cloud Computing, Intelligent Agents, Web Development, Cybersecurity, and Databases.
